candidate: offline five-lane research worker: ADTOF-PyTorch drums + Open-Unmix UMXHQ bass + Basic-Pitch TFLite bass onset

drums.license_status: The port has no LICENSE file in the inspected repository. Its upstream ADTOF source is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; do not ship this port or weight until compatible weight/code licensing is recorded.

bass_separation.architecture: one UMXHQ stereo three-layer bidirectional LSTM target with residual; offline only
bass_separation.license_status: Open-Unmix code is MIT. The inspected documentation does not state a separate redistributable license for this UMXHQ weight; record it before delivery.

bass_onset.runtime: TensorFlow Lite on Linux; the package's code is Apache-2.0
bass_onset.constraint: Basic Pitch documents that it works best on one instrument at a time, so it must receive the separated bass signal and is not a mixed-audio bass classifier.

not_measured: model accuracy on any clean held corpus
decision: A concrete desktop research profile exists. It is not a standalone-norns delivery candidate until compatible licenses and a bounded ARM native runtime replace Torch/Python dependencies and the RD-02 corpus gates pass.
